partner_contracts_dates_check.name: partner_contracts_dates_check
partner_contracts_dates_check.value: "partner_contracts"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "partner_contracts"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "partner_contracts"."ends_on" >= "partner_contracts"."starts_on"

partner_contracts_accepted_check.name: partner_contracts_accepted_check
partner_contracts_accepted_check.value: "partner_contracts"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "partner_contracts"."terms_sha256" IS NOT NULL

partner_resources_source_check.name: partner_resources_source_check
partner_resources_source_check.value: ("partner_resources"."file_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("partner_resources"."url" IS NOT NULL)

partners_scores_range.name: partners_scores_range
partners_scores_range.value: ("partners"."quality_score" IS NULL OR "partners"."quality_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND ("partners"."satisfaction_score" IS NULL OR "partners"."satisfaction_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

referrals_values_positive.name: referrals_values_positive
referrals_values_positive.value: ("referrals"."estimated_value_cents" IS NULL OR "referrals"."estimated_value_cents" >= 0) AND ("referrals"."deal_value_cents" IS NULL OR "referrals"."deal_value_cents" >= 0)

revenue_receipts_installment_check.name: revenue_receipts_installment_check
revenue_receipts_installment_check.value: ("revenue_receipts"."kind" = 'recurring') = ("revenue_receipts"."installment_number" IS NOT NULL) AND ("revenue_receipts"."installment_number" IS NULL OR "revenue_receipts"."installment_number" >= 1)
